title: (Updated) Exchange Online: Retirement of Basic authentication for SMTP AUTH client submission

details.name: Summary
details.value: (Updated) Exchange Online: Retirement of Basic authentication for SMTP AUTH client submission

body.content:
SMTP AUTH client submission with Basic authentication will be retired.

What you need to do to prepare: Move devices and applications that send mail with SMTP AUTH to OAuth, or to a connector-based relay.

 

Use the SMTP AUTH clients report to find affected senders.
